notes.title: ◈ Patch Notes (UPDATE 1.1.2)
notes.content:
Hello,
This is FOCUS on YOU.

We would like to inform you regarding the game’s features 
as well as the end of sales for related products.
Please see below for more details.

Thank you.

* Change to Game Features
       - “Voice recognition” feature
          This feature will no longer be available after 
          maintenance on May 18, 2021 (Tue).

notes.title: ◈ Patch Notes (UPDATE 1.0.8 & 1.0.9)
notes.content:
1. Valentine's Day Event Patch
- Only available between 2/14 and 2/21.
- You can earn Valentine's Day costumes for free if you log on during that period.

2. Patch for Summer Vacation Events
- Only available between 8/1 and 8/31
- You can earn Summer Vacation costumes for free if you log on during that period.

3. Minor bug fix
- Fixed an error due to sound setting
- Modify the controller operation method (Oculus Quest 2)

notes.title: ◈ Patch Notes (UPDATE 1.0.6)
notes.content:
1. 12 additional images in the Album
2. Fixed issue with certain controllers
3. Miscellaneous game improvements

It's been one hundred days since you and YUA started dating. What will she say when you give her your present?
Check out the new DLC!

<Bonuses>
1. 3 new costumes & 2 new hairstyles for YUA
2. 200 voice recognition tickets

tags.feature: 3 new costumes & 2 new hairstyles for YUA

notes.title: ◈ Patch Notes (UPDATE 1.0.2)
notes.content:
1. Corrected photo judging errors after stair shooting
- Modification of the phenomenon in which Han Yua did not react normally in the scene of the viewing of the picture even though she took a picture with focus on the stairs.
2. Improved Shadow Quality
- Shadow improvement across indoor scenes
3. Corrected loading window errors in HMD, such as Oculus Rift S, etc.
4. Corrected the error of achieving Cafe latte trophy (requires a successful retry)
5. Fixed intermittent crush phenomena only in Steam accounts 
6. Applying the Guide UI to the No Streaming Section
- Prints the images available/disable, screen shot uploadable/not possible icon on the loading screen
7. Temporarily blocked Voice Recognition Ticket purchase
